subject: 💚 Welfare Check-in — We're Just Checking You're OK
body:
Hi $student_name,

We're getting in touch because something on your record (attendance, a missed deadline, or a referral from staff) suggests it might be a tough patch. There is nothing wrong with hearing from us — this is not a disciplinary message and there is no consequence to ignoring it. We just want to make sure you know what's available.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CHECK-IN SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Check-in ID:    $checkin_id
Logged By:      $logged_by
Logged On:      $checkin_date
Your Mood:      $mood_summary
Reason Flag:    $reason_summary

NOTES
$checkin_notes

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SUPPORT AVAILABLE

  • Student Wellbeing Service — confidential 1:1 appointments (wellbeing@university.edu).
  • Counselling — short-term therapy, online or in person, free for students.
  • Academic Support — extensions, mitigating circumstances, or a study plan reset.
  • Financial Hardship Fund — emergency grants for unexpected costs.
  • Out-of-hours: Nightline on 0800-xxx-xxxx if you need someone to talk to tonight.

If any of the above would help, the easiest next step is to book a 20-minute chat with a wellbeing adviser via the Student Portal. If you'd rather just reply to this email, that works too — a real human reads it.

You don't have to be in crisis to reach out. Take care of yourself.

With warmth,
Student Wellbeing Team
